method.dataset: SHAKE256(rewind-capture-profile-v1), split into one or many equal-sized distinct files; root directory only
method.patch: XOR 4096 bytes at chosen file midpoint +137; middle file in many-file dataset
method.cache: warm/uncontrolled; generated then SHA-256 validated before each fresh capture; no cache eviction
method.timers: Instant wall timers in a disposable source copy; exclusive children subtracted; inclusive high-level stages overlap
method.io_counts: Rust read/write/sync_all calls and publication attempts; not an OS-wide syscall or physical-disk-write trace
method.cpu_rss: native /usr/bin/time; elapsed includes launcher/startup; instrumented elapsed also includes profile export
method.validation: unmodified and instrumented roots/chunk-store sizes equal; A/B restore maps verified after source renamed
